theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_radius_liminf_annulus_le_of_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (x₁ : Euclid P) (ρ d : ℝ), μ (ball x₁ ρ) ≠ ∞ → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (μ (ball x₁ r)).toReal) d ρ → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | ρ - h < dist x x₁ ∧ dist x x₁ < ρ}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal d
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
